installer-gui-script.title: SwiftX11 — X11 Server for macOS

choice.title: SwiftX11 Application
choice.description: The SwiftX11 X11 server application. Installed to /Applications.

choice.title: X11 Fonts (PCF)
choice.description: Standard X11 bitmap fonts (misc, 75dpi, 100dpi). Required for legacy X11 applications like xterm, xcalc, xclock. Installed to /opt/X11/share/fonts/. Not needed if XQuartz is already installed.
